title: TrustSER: On the Trustworthiness of Fine-tuning Pre-trained Speech Embeddings For Speech Emotion Recognition
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on system performance, privacy, safety, fairness (based on gender), and sustainability for speech emotion recognition models.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
